notifications.title: Placeholders, Agent Testing and new LLMs
notifications.content:
Hi everyone 👋

We’re excited to share another major update from the Genum team — this one is big.


| Update | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Placeholders** | Genum now supports dynamic prompt blocks 🎉 Add a `{{key}}` to your prompt, define the variants it can switch between, and pick one per run in the playground, a test case or the API. Placeholders are versioned with every commit and replace the old Memory feature. [Learn more](https://docs.genum.ai/placeholders) |
| **Agent Testing & OpenTelemetry** | Send traces from your own agents over OpenTelemetry and see every run as a session in Logs. Turn a session into a test case that checks which tools were called, with which arguments, and what the model answered — replayed with the recorded tool results, across multiple turns. [Learn more](https://docs.genum.ai/Integration/integration-opentelemetry) |
| **Prompt API** | Manage prompts end to end through the API: create a prompt with its model and settings and run it right away, then fetch the exact committed instruction with the new render endpoint. [Learn more](https://docs.genum.ai/Integration/integration-api) |
| **DeepSeek & New Models** | DeepSeek is now a built-in provider with **DeepSeek V4 Flash** and **DeepSeek V4 Pro**. We’ve also added the **GPT-6** and **GPT-5.6** families, **Claude Opus 5.5**, **Sonnet 5.5**, **Haiku 5.5** and **Fable 5.1**, and **Gemini 3.5–3.8 Flash** — 30 new models in total, many with selectable reasoning effort. Shut-down models are now blocked with a suggested replacement, and deprecated ones show their shutdown date. |
| **Cost & Usage Insights** | Run costs now account for cached input and reasoning tokens, and the playground and logs show the split for every run. Track usage per API key with the new API Key Activity card on your dashboard. |
| **Continuous Optimization** | We’re continuously improving Genum under the hood — the first page load is about four times smaller, security is tighter, and many fixes make the platform more stable for production use. |

## 💬 What’s Next

We’re not slowing down.

More improvements for agent workflows, integrations, and enterprise-grade capabilities are on the way.

Thanks for building with us ❤️

Let’s keep pushing practical, production-ready AI forward.

**The Genum Team**

notifications.title: Roles and LLM Whitelist
notifications.content:
Hi everyone 👋  

We’re excited to share another important update from the Genum team — focused on governance and team collaboration.


| Update | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Roles & Workspaces** | We’ve introduced flexible roles and structured workspaces. Configure access permissions, organize teams, and collaborate securely in larger environments with fine-grained control. [Learn more](https://docs.genum.ai/teamwork) |
| **Model Whitelist** | You can now define which LLM models are allowed in your workspace. All projects use only approved models — including custom LLM providers. This gives you stronger governance, cost control, and compliance across your environment. [Learn more](https://docs.genum.ai/llm-providers) |

## 🔐 Why This Matters

Genum continues evolving into an enterprise-ready PromptOps platform:

- Centralized model governance  
- Secure team collaboration  
- Clear responsibility boundaries  
- Better compliance and cost management  

## 💬 What’s Next

More improvements in access control, scalability, and enterprise capabilities are on the way.

Thanks for building with us ❤️  

Let’s keep pushing practical, production-ready AI forward.

**The Genum Team**

notifications.content:

notifications.title: GENUM Major Updates
notifications.content:
Hi everyone 👋

We’re excited to share a major update from the Genum team — this one is big.


| Update | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Open Source & Self-Hosted** | Genum is now open source 🎉 You can run your own fully self-hosted Genum instance with complete control over data and infrastructure. If Genum helps you, a ⭐ GitHub star is a huge support for the project. **[Learn more](https://docs.genum.ai/self-hosted)** |
| **Custom LLM Providers** | Connect local models (LM Studio, Ollama, self-hosted endpoints), integrate non-OpenAI vendors, and run fully offline or hybrid setups. No lock-in — your models, your infrastructure. **[Learn more](https://docs.genum.ai/llm-providers)** |
| **New OpenAI & Gemini Models** | Use the latest OpenAI and Gemini models directly inside your existing Genum workflows, without migration or reconfiguration. |


## 💬 Join Us

Genum is built in the open — feedback, issues, PRs, and ideas are more than welcome.

Thanks for being part of the journey ❤️

Let’s build practical, production-ready AI together.



**The Genum Team**

notifications.title: GENUM September Update
notifications.content:
At **Genum**, we’re building the **instruction layer between LLMs and human intent** — and this month, we’ve pushed it even further.


## 🌟 What’s New

### Team Work  
Collaborate with teammates, share prompts, and manage projects together — all in one secure workspace.

### Community Forum  
A new hub to connect, exchange ideas, and explore real-world use cases with other prompt engineers.

### Night Scheme & Redesigned Playground  
A fresh, clean interface and dark mode — perfect for those late-night prompting sessions.

### Updated API & Team Docs  
Deeper guides, improved examples, and new tutorials for seamless prompt collaboration.

### YouTube Channel  
Watch real use case videos showing how to build **reliable AI automations** with GENUM.

## ❤️ Why You’ll Love It

**GENUM** is built to make your GenAI development **structured**, **testable**, and **predictable** — so you can focus on **logic, not chaos**.

We value your feedback — tell us what works, what doesn’t, and what you’d love to see next.  
Every idea helps us make **GENUM** the most **user-friendly** and **reliable prompt infrastructure** out there.

Let’s keep building the future of **deterministic GenAI** — together.
